title: Solutions to Two Problems of Sárközy and Sós on Additive Representation Functions
summary: For a set $A\subseteq\mathbb{N}_0$, let $r_1(A,n)$ denote the number of solutions of the equation $a+a^{\prime}=n$ with $a,a^{\prime}\in A$, and let $r_2(A,n)$ denote the number of such solutions subject to $a\le a^{\prime}$. These functions are called additive representation functions (as first considered by Erdős, Sárközy and Sós). In this paper, we resolve two problems posed by Sárközy and Sós in 1997.
